title: Tiberi's doubling on bassoon and other instruments
summary: Tiberi doubles legitimately on instruments like bassoon, giving a classical tone to pieces such as Pavane.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: And I think he represents another discernible change in your band, some other bands, and certainly young players, and that is doubling on so many different instruments. I'm thinking of the bassoon particularly.
And being able to do it quite legi-
Yeah. He brings a classical tone, without him that pavanne wouldn't sound the same.

Well, he's -- I don't think there are too many Frank Tiberians around. If he was a man of his kind, he would be now in Atlantic City, probably the subcontractor at the gaming place or something. But he's not a man of his time, he's a man who still has the spirit to be out here.
